bifrost: bifrost_app::spellcheck (words tokenizer), bifrost_ui::text (word boundaries), bifrost_ui::detect (data detectors), bifrost_app::locale
summary: BifrOSt has a word tokenizer (alphanumeric runs for spelling) and pattern-based data detection for links, dates, addresses and phone numbers. It has no language recognizer, no linguistic tagger (parts of speech, named entities, lemmas), no embeddings and no custom text model runtime; Locale only knows English and Icelandic.

features.apple: NLTokenizer, NLTokenUnit word, sentence, paragraph, document
features.note: word units only: words() splits on alphanumeric runs and keeps inner apostrophes; no sentence or paragraph units and no locale-aware segmentation (docs/bifrost-ui.md:672 says no UAX #29 and no CJK dictionary segmentation)

Wave 2 (natural-language, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no text-to-language detection anywhere in the SDK or shell; the only language values are the two user-selected Locale languages

Wave 2 (theme-14, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. no script classifier; text rendering uses the font engine (springboard/render/src/font.rs) without a script API for apps

features.feature: Parts of speech and lexical tagging (NLTagger, NLTag lexical class)
features.note: no part-of-speech or lemma data; the spellcheck dictionary is a plain word list (springboard/apps/keyboard/src/words/en.txt) with no tags

features.apple: NLTagger with NLTagScheme.nameType, NLTag personalName, placeName, organizationName
features.note: pattern-based data detection only; people, places and organizations are not recognised, and the detector result is not merged with the spell checker (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1429)

features.feature: Spelling-aware word lookup (companion, not Apple NL)
features.apple: NSSpellChecker is in AppKit, not Natural Language; listed here because Apple's NL word units feed it
features.note: edit-distance-1 suggestions over a word list; no grammar, no bundled dictionary, no app adopts it yet (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1426-1429)

features.bifrost: none found in springboard/sdk/src or springboard/ui/src
features.note: no vector model and no distance API for apps; quicksearch matches keywords and titles only (springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs:18, :33)
no on-device contextual model and no asset loader; Apple downloads per-script assets, which has no BifrOSt counterpart yet

features.feature: Custom text models (NLModel, Create ML text classifier and word tagger)
features.apple: NLModel, Create ML text classifier and word tagger
features.note: no API to load or run a trained text model in apps; the shell has no ML text runtime

features.feature: Locale-aware text formatting (related to language data)
features.apple: Not in Natural Language; listed as the closest locale service
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Locale), springboard/ui/src/format.rs (number, date, byte, measurement formatters)
features.note: built-in data covers en and is only (docs/bifrost-ui.md:1343); no plural rules and no other languages

gaps: Language recognizer: no text language detection and no hypotheses API
Linguistic tagger: no lexical class, lemma, name type or script tags for apps
Embeddings: no word or sentence vectors and no nearest-neighbour search for apps
Custom NLModel runtime for classifiers and word taggers
Sentence and paragraph tokenization; word segmentation is alphanumeric runs, not UAX #29
Named entity recognition: data detectors cover only link, date, address and phone
